assimilation_semantics.source_admission: Every output that self-reports successful completion is eligible; external scores remain hidden.
assimilation_semantics.diversity_signal: SHA-256 identity of local implementation files only. The router ignores evaluator outputs, test results, scratch data, test_*.py files, and hidden benchmark state.
assimilation_semantics.bounded_routing: Every recipient receives at most the three most recent eligible outputs with distinct implementation identities, selected across frozen bootstrap sources and all completed layers.
assimilation_semantics.history_retention: When the current layer collapses to one implementation, distinct older implementations remain eligible to fill the fixed three-reference bundle.
assimilation_semantics.held_fixed: Provider, model, task, worker count, bootstrap sources, action budget, temperature, prompt blinding, self-report gate, evaluator, per-source cap, and reference cap match the bounded-recent control.

validity_gates.target_consistency: All 18 evaluations use Core total 4, all-test total 37, and the frozen collection hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: Every interpreted output has at least one model step and no terminal API error.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No prompt contains external Core/all-test scores, failed-test names, or the hidden test hash.
validity_gates.reference_count: Every worker at every layer receives exactly three references.
validity_gates.local_only_routing: Every delivered identity is derivable from local implementation files without reading evaluation.json or inference scores.
validity_gates.prohibited_access: No assistant action accesses benchmark catalogs, hidden tests, or external evaluation paths.

outcome_rule.primary_diversity_endpoint: Sum of unique primary implementation hashes over layers 2-6, with bounded-recent control value fixed at 5.
outcome_rule.support: The mitigation preserves diversity if the endpoint exceeds 5 and at least one post-layer-1 layer contains two or more primary implementations.
outcome_rule.strong_support: At least two post-layer-1 layers contain two or more primary implementations while every worker remains Core-complete.
outcome_rule.null: All layers 2-6 contain one primary implementation, matching bounded-recent lock-in.
outcome_rule.performance_guard: Report all-test score, Core score, input tokens, and latency jointly with diversity; do not call a diversity gain a net improvement if task quality materially decreases.
outcome_rule.forbidden_claim: One cfgpipe run cannot establish a universal mitigation or eliminate the need for cross-task validation.
